## About the Job Board

Please feel free to contact BTR about posting to the job board using our job board [request form](mailto:bridgingtransport@gmail.com?subject=Job%20Board%20Posting%20Request). 

**Note:** These listings are provided free-of-charge to our colleagues from around the world. We provide no guarantee that a posting remains active.

## Job Posting Request

We are delighted you wish to post a job with us! The job board is a place to post undergraduate researcher, graduate student, postdoctoral associate, and research associate, or any other positions in the transportation field for members of the BTR community (**free of charge**).

### How to Submit a Job Posting

To submit a job posting, please send the following information to [bridgingtransport@gmail.com](mailto:bridgingtransport@gmail.com):

- **Position Title**
- **Institution/Organization**
- **Location**
- **Position Type** (e.g., PhD, Postdoc, Faculty, Industry)
- **Application Deadline**
- **Brief Description**
- **Contact Information**
- **Application Link/Instructions**

Please send your institution's logo to [bridgingtransport@gmail.com](mailto:bridgingtransport@gmail.com) if you wish it included with your job posting.

## Contact

For questions about job postings or to submit a new listing, contact us at [bridgingtransport@gmail.com](mailto:bridgingtransport@gmail.com).
